name: CL1232.5-1250 outskirts (Hubble)
blurb: An outskirts field of the galaxy cluster CL1232.5-1250, seen by Hubble.
label: cl12321-hubble
story: This field sits on the outskirts of a distant galaxy cluster, in the region where galaxies fall inward; Hubble came here to learn what turns spiral galaxies into lenticulars.

claims.text: CL1232.5-1250 is a galaxy cluster in the ESO Distant Cluster Survey (EDisCS)
CL1232-1 is a Hubble pointing of program 13393, which imaged positions in the outskirts of intermediate-redshift galaxy clusters
Program 13393 studies galaxy transformation in the infall regions of clusters
The program seeks what transforms spiral galaxies into lenticular (S0) galaxies
